title: Mouse Intestinal Organoid Time-Course Experiments from Single Cells
author: Denise Serra
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.2.9220/v1
materials: Sample preparation and single cell seeding

steps.title: Harvest Organoids from Culture
steps.instruction: Collect organoids from 24-well plates where they are cultured in 50 µl/well of 1:1 Matrigel/culture maintenance medium with 500 µl of maintenance medium.

substeps.instruction: Remove medium from the wells.
Collect Matrigel droplets into a falcon tube using 0.5 ml of ice-cold PBS per well.
Centrifuge the tube for 5 min at 400 rcf and 4°C to pellet the organoids.

steps.title: Dissociate Organoids into Single Cells
steps.instruction: Dissociate the organoid pellet into single cells using Tryple and Rock inhibitor.

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatant and re-suspend the pellet in Tryple (100 µl Tryple with 10 µM Rock inhibitor per collected well).
Incubate for 20 min at 37°C, performing harsh pipetting every five minutes.
Add DMEM/F-12 (approximately 3 times the volume of Tryple used).
Centrifuge for 5 min at 400 rcf and 4°C.
Discard supernatant and re-suspend the pellet in 0.5 ml of cold PBS containing 10 µM Rock inhibitor.

steps.title: Filter and Sort Single Cells
steps.instruction: Filter the cell suspension and use FACS to isolate single alive cells.

substeps.instruction: Filter the cell suspension through a 30 µm cell strainer directly into a FACS sorting tube.
Keep samples on ice until sorting (ideally within 30 min).
Prepare a 1.5 ml Eppendorf collection tube containing 200 µl of ENR medium supplemented with 10 µM Rock inhibitor and store on ice.
FACS sort single alive cells into the prepared collection tube.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Seeding
steps.instruction: Prepare the sorted cells in a Matrigel mix for plating.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the collection tube for 5 min at 800 rcf and 4°C.
Carefully discard supernatant.
Re-suspend the pellet in a 1:1 ratio of ENR medium and Matrigel to achieve a final concentration of ~3000 cells/5 µl droplet (acceptable range: 2500-5000 cells/5 µl droplet).

steps.title: Seed Cells in 96-Well Plate
steps.instruction: Seed the cell suspension into a 96-well plate and allow droplets to solidify.

substeps.instruction: Seed a 5 µl droplet of the prepared cell suspension into each well of a 96-well plate.
Incubate the plate for 15-20 min at 37°C in an incubator to let the droplets solidify.
Add 100 µl/well of ENR medium supplemented with 20% Wnt3a-CM, 10 µM Rock inhibitor, and 3 µM CHIR99021.

steps.title: Maintain and Perturb Organoids
steps.instruction: Maintain the cultures according to the experimental design (no perturbation or specific compound treatment).

substeps.instruction: For experiments without perturbations: Replace medium after 24h with 100 µl ENR medium + 20% Wnt3a-CM + 10 µM Rock inhibitor; replace medium after 72h with 100 µl ENR medium only.
For Verteporfin treatment: Remove ENR medium and add 100 µl/well of 5 µM Verteporfin or DMSO in ENR medium at the time point of interest; change medium daily with fresh compound and supplements.
For Inducible hYap1 overexpression: Remove ENR medium and add 100 µl/well of 0.05 µg/ml Doxycycline hyclate or ddH2O in ENR medium at the time point of interest; change medium daily.

For Inducible Lats1/2 double knock-out: 24h before single cell isolation, culture organoids in 24-well plate in 500 µl/well of 1 µg/ml 4-Hydroxytamoxifen or DMSO in ENR medium; grow single cells in normal ENR medium until fixation.
For DAPT treatment: Remove ENR medium and add 100 µl/well of 10 µM DAPT or DMSO in ENR medium at the time point of interest; change medium daily.
For Ly411575 or MK-0752 treatment: Remove ENR medium and add 100 µl/well of 0.5 µM Ly411575 or MK-0752 or DMSO in ENR medium; change medium daily.
For CHIR99021 or IWP-2 treatment: Remove ENR medium and add 100 µl/well of 5 µM CHIR99021 or 2 µM IWP-2 (or corresponding DMSO) in ENR medium at the time point of interest; change medium daily.
For EREG treatment: Remove ENR medium and add 100 µl/well of 0.5 µg/ml EREG or PBS in ENR medium at the time point of interest; change medium daily.

steps.title: Fix Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the 96-well plate for immunostaining via fixation.

substeps.instruction: Spin the 96-well plate at 3000 rpm for 10 min in a pre-cooled centrifuge at 10°C.
Wash each well once with 100 µl of PBS.
Add 100 µl of 4% PFA (diluted in PBS) for 45 min at room temperature.
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 µl/well).

steps.title: General Immunostaining Protocol
steps.instruction: Perform standard immunostaining on the fixed organoids.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl of permeabilization buffer, incubate for 1h at room temperature (shake at 300 rpm).
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 µl/well).
Add 100 µl of blocking buffer for 1h at room temperature (shake at 300 rpm).
Add 60 µl/well of primary antibody (diluted in blocking buffer) for 2h at room temperature or overnight at 4°C.
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 µl/well).
Add 100 µl/well of secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in blocking buffer) for 1h at room temperature (shake at 300 rpm).
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 µl/well).
Stain nuclei with 100 µl/well DAPI (20 µg/ml in ddH2O) for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 µl/well).
Stain cell outlines by adding 100 µl/well of CellTrace dye (final concentration 1 µg/ml in CellTrace buffer) for 10 min at room temperature.
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 µl/well).

steps.title: Optional: Optical Clearing
steps.instruction: Improve optical penetration depth for confocal z-stacks.

substeps.instruction: Incubate each well in 100 µl of optical clearing solution at room temperature for 20 min until transparent.
Replace with 100 µl of fresh optical clearing solution and image.
Remove solution by washing with PBS after imaging to prevent bleaching.

steps.title: Alternative: 4i Immunofluorescence Protocol
steps.instruction: Perform iterative indirect immunofluorescence imaging (4i) for multiplexing.

substeps.instruction: Permeabilize with 100 µl/well of -20°C Methanol for 30 min at -20°C.
Wash 3 times shortly with PBS (100 µl/well), followed by 3 x 10 min washes with PBS (200 µl/well, shake at 300 rpm).
Add 100 µl/well of multiplexing blocking buffer for 1h at room temperature (shake at 300 rpm).
Add 60 µl/well of primary antibody (diluted in multiplexing blocking buffer) for 2h at room temperature or overnight at 4°C.
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 µl/well).
Add 100 µl/well of secondary antibody (1:500 in multiplexing blocking buffer) for 1h at room temperature (shake at 300 rpm).
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 µl/well).
Stain nuclei with 100 µl/well DAPI (20 µg/ml in ddH2O) for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 µl/well).
Stain cell outlines with 100 µl/well CellTrace dye (1 µg/ml in CellTrace buffer) for 10 min at room temperature.
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 µl/well).
Add 200 µl/well of imaging buffer and image.
Elute antibodies by washing 3 x 10 min with elution buffer (100 µl/well) at room temperature (shake at 300 rpm).
Wash 3 times shortly with PBS (100 µl/well), followed by 3 x 10 min washes with PBS (200 µl/well, shake at 300 rpm).
Re-block with 100 µl/well multiplexing blocking buffer for 1h at room temperature (shake at 300 rpm).
Repeat staining for the next round: add 60 µl/well primary antibody, wash 3x, add 100 µl/well secondary antibody, wash 3x, re-stain nuclei with DAPI, wash 3x, and add 200 µl/well imaging buffer.

steps.title: RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from organoids for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Seed 5000 cells/well in 30 wells of a 96-well plate per time point.
Remove culture medium and wash wells with 100 µl of PBS.
Scrape cells embedded in Matrigel using 100 µl/well of Buffer RL + b-mercaptoethanol (10 µl b-mercaptoethanol per 1 ml Buffer RL) and collect in a 15 ml falcon tube.
Add 30 µl/well of 97% ethanol to the lysate and mix by vortexing.
Follow the Single Cell RNA Purification Kit protocol (Section 2), optionally including DNase treatment, and elute RNA in 20 µl of Elution Solution A.
